paragraphs: The E-Pace D200 uses the Ingenium AJ200D — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel engine that's part of Jaguar Land Rover's modular Ingenium family. It's been fitted to the E-Pace across the entire X540 production run from 2017 onwards. The AJ200D shares the same basic architecture as the petrol AJ200, but features diesel-specific components including high-pressure fuel injection, a DPF system and EGR. Like other Ingenium diesels in the JLR range, the AJ200D has a documented timing chain wear pattern at higher mileages — which is why we replace the timing chain components and injector seals as standard on every rebuild.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ200D engines for every E-Pace D200 on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to the E-Pace D200 from 2017 onwards across the entire X540 generation. Known for timing chain and injector seal wear over time — see the callout above. We replace the timing chain, tensioners, guide rails, injector seals, EGR and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D rebuild.

compatibility.intro: Because the E-Pace D200 uses a single engine family across its entire production run, compatibility matching is more straightforward than on some other models — but correct fitment still depends on confirming your exact generation, drivetrain specification and any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build.
